enumdef.name: lv_color_format
enumdef.help: Color format of the buffer the gif is decoded to

enum.name: xrgb8888
enum.help: 32 bit RGB, the alpha byte is unused

prop.name: src
prop.help: The source for the gif (raw data or a file)

prop.name: loop_count
prop.help: Number of repeats. If not set the information form the gif will be used

prop.name: color_format
prop.help: Color format to decode the gif to. Set it before `src` to decode only once

prop.name: auto_pause_invisible
prop.help: Pause the gif while it is not visible

part.name: main
part.help: Style the GIF: `image_recolor`, `image_recolor_opa` and `image_opa`. Background, border, etc can be added too.
